tools.name: audio.health
tools.description: Report corpus size, source organizations, engine ceiling and secret policy.

tools.name: audio.search
tools.description: Search original audio-engineering notes by words in the title, summary or source id.

tools.name: audio.topic
tools.description: Return one audio-engineering note with its public source pointers.

id.description: Topic id, such as sampling-nyquist or pt-br-phonetics.

tools.name: audio.sources
tools.description: List the consulted public sources, optionally filtered by organization.

org.description: Optional organization or source id fragment.

tools.name: audio.calculate
tools.description: Evaluate one named acoustic formula: nyquist, wavelength, sabine, eyring, erb, cents or note.

arguments.description: Numeric inputs for the chosen formula.

tools.name: audio.voice_profile
tools.description: Return the acoustic preset for a presentation and age, without rendering audio.

tools.name: audio.render_voice
tools.description: Render an original parametric voice to a WAV file and a JSON manifest. Refuses cloning, impersonation and sexual use.

text.description: Text to speak, or a label when phonemes are supplied.

out_dir.description: Directory under the working tree or /tmp.

use_context.description: Why the voice is being rendered.

intonation.description: auto, declarative, question, narrow or flat.
